source_note: 页图逐页视觉核对；JJ 为红衣人物，Mikey 为绿色人物，speaker 依据气泡尾部与人物位置标注。字幕按实际停顿拆分为原子句，使用 faster-whisper VAD 与 no-VAD 双跑词级时间戳交叉核对。b3-p01-s04、b3-p01-s06、b3-p10-s01 保留画面中的停顿省略号，作为同一人声单位并在校验命令中显式豁免 compound guard。Peep peep、RUMBLE、CRACK、WHEEEE、爆炸音等为画面音效或拟声字，没有对应人声，未伪造句音频。源 PDF、MP3 与页图只读。

pages.text_en: Mikey! What is the emergency? Look, JJ! It's a... a... PENGUIN! I speak animal. She says her mom is on top of... Snow Mountain. Snow Mountain?! That is super far away! We have to move FAST!

sentences.text_en: She says her mom is on top of... Snow Mountain.
sentences.zh: 她说她妈妈在……雪山顶上。

pages.text_en: Snack time! Do you like crunchy carrots? Mikey! Penguins do NOT eat carrots! I caught a fresh fish! YAY! YUMMY TIME!

sentences.zh: 你喜欢脆脆的胡萝卜吗？
我钓到了一条新鲜的鱼！

pages.text_en: Uh oh! The bridge went "kaboom." Oh no! This is the ONLY way to Snow Mountain! Wait... I have an EXPLOSIVE idea! Ooh! Are we making fireworks?

sentences.text_en: This is the ONLY way to Snow Mountain!
sentences.zh: 这可是去雪山的唯一道路！
我有一个爆炸性的主意！

pages.text_en: Behold! The Person Cannon! It uses TNT to blast us across the gap! Probably! Is this safe? Get ready! Blast off in 3... 2... 1... Wait! I need to go potty first!

sentences.text_en: It uses TNT to blast us across the gap!
sentences.zh: 它用 TNT 把我们轰过缺口！

sentences.text_en: I need to go potty first!

pages.text_en: I can FLLLLYYYYYY! Nice landing! We made it across! Let's never do that again.

sentences.zh: 我们再也不要那样做了。

pages.text_en: Mikey! This thunder is dangerous! We need cover! Nah, it's just a little sparkle rain! Mikey!!!

sentences.text_en: Nah, it's just a little sparkle rain!
sentences.zh: 不，这只是小小的闪光雨！

pages.text_en: He's in a lightning coma! I need to make a Healing Potion! But I need a WATERMELON! Gotta run! Sorry, zombies. No time to chat!

sentences.text_en: I need to make a Healing Potion!

pages.text_en: Alchemy time! Mixing gold and melon to save my best friend! Healing potion go! Wow! I feel super-charged! Thanks, JJ!

sentences.text_en: Mixing gold and melon to save my best friend!
sentences.zh: 把金子和瓜混合起来，拯救我最好的朋友！

pages.text_en: JJ... why is the water looking at me? I sense a disturbance... Prepare yourself! Laser, you giant lizard! SAVE ME!!!!

sentences.text_en: JJ... why is the water looking at me?

pages.text_en: Huff... puff... I can't believe... you had a laser gun... Never leave home... without it. We made it to the top! Mission accomplished! The family is together! I love happy endings!

sentences.text_en: Huff... puff... I can't believe... you had a laser gun...
sentences.zh: 呼……呼……我真不敢相信……你居然有激光枪……
永远不要离开家……不带上它。

sentences.text_en: We made it to the top!
